fusions.name: Seam Growth
fusions.desc: Drives coral into the seams of the target's armour, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Bristling Plates
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Stinging spines grow out through your plating and stab every enemy within 2 tiles for 6 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Cement
fusions.desc: After 2 seconds of growth, raises your armour by 25% for 30 seconds.

fusions.name: Hammered Thicker
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (45% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour also rises by 5%.
